mechanism_inventory: access-control mismatch (UTBOwned.setUtb/BaseAdapter.setBridgeExecutor use two separate admin systems — Owned vs onlyAdmin — no cross-chain identity enforcement)
missing invariant enforcement (Operable.setOperator casts _operator to payable while operator is address — silent mismatch, no validation)
unauthorized state deletion (no zero-address guard on setUtb/setBridgeExecutor/setOperator — can be set to address(0), bricking protected functions)
wrong lifecycle ordering (operator/utb/bridgeExecutor overwritable at any time without pausing active operations)
access-control mismatch — dual admin model fragmentation (Operable/Roles uses OZ AccessControl while UTBOwned uses solmate Owned; unlinked role systems)
external-call failure / DoS (setting bridgeExecutor or utb to a dead address makes all onlyExecutor/onlyUtb functions permanently revert)

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: No zero-address validation on setUtb, setBridgeExecutor, or setOperator. Any of these critical role addresses can be set to address(0) by owner/admin, permanently DoSing all functions guarded by onlyUtb/onlyExecutor/onlyOperator. No recovery path shown in-scope.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Owner/admin (privileged) calls setUtb(address(0)) etc., accidentally or maliciously. No check rejects the zero address.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Owner calls setUtb(address(0)). 2. utb is address(0). 3. onlyUtb functions require(msg.sender==utb)==require(msg.sender==address(0)) => always revert. 4. Cross-chain execution path permanently bricked. Same for setBridgeExecutor(0) and setOperator(0).
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Protocol users / LPs — cross-chain bridge operations permanently DoS'd with no recovery unless owner re-calls setter (permanent if key lost/renounced).
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: No economic gain; DoS/liveness. Malicious insider or key compromise could weaponize.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Missing zero-address guard with direct DoS impact on privileged modifiers; clears Medium, potentially High if funds locked in-flight.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: Operable.setOperator casts _operator (address) to payable when assigning to operator (declared address). Type-confusion / design inconsistency; no validation on _operator beyond what the zero-address mechanism covers.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Admin calls setOperator with a controlled address; the payable cast rejects nothing.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: Not independently exploitable beyond the zero-address path; code-smell.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Source: operator = payable(_operator) where operator is address. Distinct locus (type consistency vs presence check); low/code-quality at minimum.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Dual admin model fragmentation — UTBOwned (solmate Owned) vs Operable/Roles (OZ AccessControl) as separate unlinked role systems
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: UTBOwned inherits solmate Owned (owner=msg.sender); Operable inherits Roles granting DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender; no linkage shown.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Do any in-scope contracts inherit BOTH simultaneously, creating a split-admin surface? Provided source shows BaseAdapter->UTBOwned but not a contract inheriting Operable alongside UTBOwned.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Protocol users if a contract inherits both — partial key compromise manipulates one role system while the other is intact.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Race condition — setUtb/setBridgeExecutor/setOperator overwritable mid-operation without pause/lock
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: No pause guard or operation lock on any setter; storage updated immediately.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether rotation between bridge send and receive is operationally feasible and bricks in-flight delivery.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Users with in-flight cross-chain txns — funds may be stuck if executor rotated before delivery.

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: Unauthorized external actor calling setUtb/setBridgeExecutor/setOperator directly
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: setUtb/setBridgeExecutor guarded by onlyOwner; setOperator by onlyAdmin (hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)). Unprivileged EOA cannot pass.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Modifiers enforce owner/admin; unprivileged calls revert.

impact_direction.victim_loses: Cross-chain bridge functionality — onlyUtb/onlyExecutor/onlyOperator functions permanently DoS'd if any role set to zero; in-flight funds risk being locked.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Role address invariants (utb/bridgeExecutor/operator != address(0)) not enforced; cross-chain liveness invariant violated.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Zero-address DoS permanently bricks all bridge-adapter users; lifecycle race affects in-flight funds; consequence borne by users though trigger is admin.
